marking_points.criterion: Traverses only that producer’s product list.
Calls mark_sold on the matching product.
Stops after that update without marking other products.

acceptable_alternatives: Equivalent technically correct wording or valid implementation earning the specified independent points.
partial_credit_notes: Award each stated point independently up to the total; do not double-credit the same idea.

verification.technical: Concrete marking points independently reasoned from the defined context and exact 2027 scope.
verification.code_check: Executable checks saved under checks/ where applicable.

test_code:
from types import SimpleNamespace
class Product:
 def __init__(self,title):self.title=title;self.calls=0
 def mark_sold(self):self.calls+=1
a,b,c=Product("A"),Product("B"),Product("C")
ps=[SimpleNamespace(name="One",products=[a,b]),SimpleNamespace(name="Two",products=[c])]
mark_sold(ps,"One","B");assert [x.calls for x in [a,b,c]]==[0,1,0]
